# Expo UI on iOS 26.5

Captured on iPhone 17 Pro with Expo Go 58.0.7 using the T3 device tools. Open
`examples/expo-ui` in Expo Go and capture at 3× with status bar normalization.
Retake screenshots until the Dynamic Island appears.

- `home` shows a content-sized host and the initial controls.
- `changed` shows one Increment tap, Notifications on, Hello submitted, and the slider moved to 75.
- `scrolled` starts at the changed state, scrolls to the bottom, and taps Embedded 0.

The same example supplies the iOS 27.2 and Android references.
